capabilities: highlight new or edited notes with rings in the graph view
track per-note last-seen timestamps in the plugin data file
mark all notes as read from a button or the command palette
customize ring color, gap, thickness, glow and pulse
draw rings in both the global graph and the local graph
extras: Desktop-only. It reads file modification times and draws into the graph view's internal PIXI renderer, relying on non-public APIs that may change in future Obsidian versions. Notes themselves are never modified; only the plugin's data.json timestamps are updated.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that marks new or recently edited notes in the graph view with a highlight ring
motivation: Built for AI-assisted workflows: when an AI assistant or automated tool writes and edits notes on your behalf, the rings show at a glance which notes it touched since you last looked.
problem: The graph view gives no indication of which notes were created or edited since you last looked at them, which is easy to lose track of when AI assistants or automated tools write notes for you.
summary: Plugin that draws highlight rings on new or recently edited notes in the graph view, with a one-click mark-all-as-read command.
